api.name: buildDiffSymbols

parameters.name: diff
parameters.purpose: Frozen per-file diff evidence and truncation/binary metadata.

returns.meaning: Small files retain one legacy row. Larger textual diffs produce ordered file-fragment rows with unique IDs and lossless source spans; binary markers remain unchanged.

errors.condition: Fragment metadata cannot represent original evidence consistently; no partial review material is returned.

preconditions: Diff evidence is captured once by the existing changed-set reader.
postconditions: Parent file -> ordered fragments is one-to-many; each fragment belongs to exactly one parent. Text ranges partition the captured diff with no gaps/overlap, and concatenation reproduces it exactly.

Use a conservative16Ki-character maximum raw span, preferring complete diff lines; a longer line uses Unicode-safe continuation spans with exact offsets. Repeated bounded header/context metadata is separate from the original evidence ranges.
Deduplicate changedFiles in first-seen order; findings retain the original file path and old/new line/column or explicit diff-offset coordinates.
Existing truncation/missing-hunk markers remain honest; fragmenting never changes incomplete input into complete evidence.

api.name: codeReviewMaterial

parameters.name: grounding
parameters.purpose: Existing symbol rows or attributed diff-fragment rows.

returns.meaning: Unique review atoms and relations that preserve parent provenance and feed the existing chunk/gather contract.

errors.condition: Duplicate IDs, invalid fragment order, missing/overlapping ranges or mismatched parent provenance.

preconditions: Graph symbol rows remain compatible and keep their existing identity.
postconditions: Fragment siblings retain parent identity and ordered adjacency; avoid a quadratic all-pairs relation expansion between fragments of one file.

For quality reviews containing diff fragments, append one check-item obligation per parent file, keyed diff-file-quality:<parentId>, covering exactly that parent's fragment IDs. Existing graph-only quality reviews retain no such obligations. Parent adjudication is explicit, not inferred from same-file relations.
No source fragment is shortened or replaced by a summary before at least one chunk reviews its complete captured text.

Quality fragment calls return evidence notes for their parent-file obligations as well as existing findings/descriptions. A parent-file gather call judges all completed fragment notes and can emit a correctness finding that no individual chunk could establish. Every fragment then receives note validation and parent-file adjudication; no single-call exemption is claimed.

parameters.name: job

parameters.purpose: Existing chunk and gather producer.

parameters.purpose: Existing configured provider through CLI OAuth abstraction.

parameters.name: opts
parameters.purpose: Cancellation, timing and progress.

returns.meaning: Existing review result after all required chunks and gather stages finish.

errors.condition: The final serialized call, including any newly added schema/context/repair content, exceeds the job limit; subdivide/reduce using existing pipeline semantics, never send it unchanged.
Required isolated structured-call semantics cannot be enforced by the selected provider.

preconditions: Each code-review model call is a fresh structured request with explicit supplied context; no CLI resume, ambient conversation history, tool-driven context growth or unmeasured project-instruction injection is allowed in the bounded diff path.

Before dispatch of a bounded structured call, require provider.capabilities.boundedStructuredInput === true; absence/false is unsupported. The provider advertises enforcement support, not merely acceptance of an unknown options field.
postconditions: Recheck complete size immediately before every provider submission; no LLM calls run in parallel.
A retry includes only explicitly rendered bounded repair/history content; if it cannot fit, redivide/reduce or fail without stamping a completed review.

Provider/system protocol overhead is conservatively accounted at the existing application input-estimation boundary; do not claim exact native-token counting. Any extra application-controlled CLI instructions/schema are included or disabled.

The driver receives the same effective job.plan.limitChars chosen at job creation and sends boundedInput:{maxInputChars:job.plan.limitChars,contextMode:isolated-structured} for every bounded chunk/gather/reduction/repair call. Unsupported-bounded-input is terminal, not a transient retry.

The parent context contains bounded file/change/coordinate metadata and the parent obligation; it does not reinsert the full file. Judge the file's correctness across notes, including contradictions and dependencies between fragments.

If notes/context exceed the same cap, use existing reduction stages retaining all departure facts and deterministic source provenance, then judge the parent once. Oversized irreducible required context fails explicitly.
This path does not depend on calls edges or on non-calls relationCall, which currently returns no checks for diff sibling relations. Sparse sibling links are grouping/context only.

dataModel.details: Add optional fragment provenance for file rows: parentId, part index/count, half-open UTF16 source offsets, original file identity, source/diff line-column coordinates and parent/content digests. Metadata describes original evidence, not a new source entity. One file owns1..N ordered fragments; each fragment belongs to one file. Graph symbol rows and small file rows remain unchanged; coverageEligible remains false for diff evidence. No IPC method or persisted user database schema changes.

The same128000-token default estimate covers all supplied messages plus actual schema/envelopes, context, prior notes/history and retry content. Diff jobs cap larger configured budgets at128000; lower budgets remain honored. Job, gather and duplicate planners share the measurement and a final provider dispatch guard. Existing opt-out measurement signatures remain source-compatible only where no schema is supplied; actual review send paths always supply it.

In src/shared/types.ts add StructuredCompletionOpts.boundedInput?: { readonly maxInputChars:number; readonly contextMode:isolated-structured } | undefined and ProviderCapabilities.boundedStructuredInput?: boolean | undefined. Omitted capability means false; omitted option preserves existing behavior. The code-review driver requires advertised support before dispatch. CliProvider may advertise true only for its enforcing implementation, then verifies installed-CLI isolation support before any model call; unknown/unsupported versions refuse with Error.code=unsupported-bounded-input. ExecutionMode structured calls gain optional inputContext:isolated for persisted intent. Normalize/measure the actual supplied schema/instructions before spawn and reject over-budget input with InputTooLargeError. No resumes, unmeasured project/hooks/tools/history or implicit context growth are admitted. OAuth remains owned by the CLI; no REST provider or global config mutation. Unsupported admission is terminal, not silently ignored or transiently retried.

errorCases.scenario: Captured diff is incomplete or truncated before span creation.
errorCases.detection: Existing reader truncation/missing-hunk markers or captured byte totals show unavailable evidence.
errorCases.response: Recover complete per-file evidence through the existing reader where possible; otherwise stop before a completed review and name the affected file/read limit. Never present omitted entries as reviewed.
errorCases.userImpact: Review remains pending until evidence can be read completely; no inventory or release-gate changes.

errorCases.scenario: Fragment ranges are missing, duplicated, reordered or inconsistent with the captured parent.
errorCases.detection: Validate parent digest, part count/order and contiguous half-open offsets; reassembly digest differs from the original.
errorCases.response: Reject material before model calls; no partial review artifact.
errorCases.userImpact: A concrete evidence-integrity error identifies the parent file.

errorCases.scenario: Complete call becomes larger than the128K budget after schema, context, history or repair additions.
errorCases.detection: The shared measurer and final normalized provider check exceed min(configured limit,384000 characters) for the actual call.
errorCases.response: Use existing redivision/reduction to create smaller complete calls; if fixed required context/schema itself cannot fit, fail explicitly. Never drop required context, resend unchanged or raise the budget.
errorCases.userImpact: More bounded serial calls, or an explicit irreducible-input error with no review stamped.

errorCases.scenario: Provider cannot prevent unmeasured session/project/tool context in bounded structured mode.
errorCases.detection: The provider lacks a verified isolation capability or cannot normalize/count its supplied instructions/schema before spawn.
errorCases.response: Refuse that bounded execution mode before the model call; do not claim the128K invariant was enforced.
errorCases.userImpact: Select/update a supported CLI adapter; ordinary completions outside this mode retain existing behavior.

errorCases.scenario: Cancellation, missing chunk answer or gather validation failure.
errorCases.detection: Existing signal/deadline checks or provenance validation notice unfinished required calls/notes. Parent-file gather also compares validated note provenance with the expected fragment set.
errorCases.response: Preserve existing stop/fail semantics; no fabricated complete verdict and no parallel retry. Missing parent evidence never uses the generic no-evidence-success branch.
errorCases.userImpact: Review stays pending with its actual failure cause.

edgeCases.input: Empty diff, binary file or small ordinary text file.
edgeCases.expected: Existing markers and single-file row behavior remain compatible; no invented graph coverage.

edgeCases.input: Pretty/minified JSON, one line far larger than a call, CRLF, emoji and non-ASCII paths.
edgeCases.expected: Unicode-safe span continuation preserves the exact evidence string, coordinates and deterministic ordered IDs; later chunks never treat an isolated fragment as a whole valid JSON document.

edgeCases.input: Added/deleted/renamed files or lines existing only on the old side.
edgeCases.expected: Original old/new paths and coordinates remain attributable; changedFiles is unique and findings stay within the original Story scope.

edgeCases.input: Many fragments in the same file/module.
edgeCases.expected: Sparse sibling connectivity and parent gather avoid new quadratic fragment-pair generation while retaining all fragment notes/provenance.

edgeCases.input: Existing configured review limit above128K or below it.
edgeCases.expected: Diff calls use the lower of configured limit and128K; schema/context reserve consumes that budget rather than increasing it.

edgeCases.input: A final gather or correction contains large prior notes/history.
edgeCases.expected: Existing bounded reduction/gather plans include those actual notes/history in measurement; no hidden accumulated transcript is resumed.

edgeCases.input: Fragmented diff whose complete quality prompt fits one call.
edgeCases.expected: requiresChunking explicitly selects measured chunk mode and parent gather; a single planned chunk is still plan.single:false and must produce parent notes.

invariantsToPreserve.text: Original changed-file scope, independent daemon reviewer and degraded diff result cap stay intact.
Existing source-symbol identities and eligible graph coverage remain unchanged; fragment rows carry no invented call/test edges.
Existing serial prepare/review/gather, cancellation and complete failure semantics are reused.
All supplied input under one128K estimate includes envelopes, schema, explicit context and history; no budget increase is an implementation workaround.
S003 evidence contents and disabled release state remain unchanged; its earlier foundation/service coverage is not silently cleared.

testStrategy.testFramework: node:test + node:assert/strict via Node22/tsx; extend the existing code-review and review-pipeline *.test.ts suites identified in s1. CLI transport isolation uses subprocess fixtures rather than a live model for deterministic limit checks.

testLevels.purpose: Prove complete evidence partition and attribution, including a minified line larger than the128K call budget.
subjects: DIFF-SPANS: added/modified/deleted/renamed text and binary/small-file compatibility; reassembly equals original diff exactly
DIFF-COORDS: CRLF, emoji, Unicode and giant-line continuations preserve offsets/old-new source locations and unique changedFiles
DIFF-INTEGRITY: duplicate/missing/reordered span and digest mismatches reject before calls
fixturesNeeded: Deterministic multi-megabyte pretty/minified inventory-style JSON and mixed unified diffs; do not rewrite the real S003 audit data.

testLevels.purpose: Prove the128K limit covers the entire sent call and all accumulated supplied context/history.
subjects: DIFF-BUDGET: at/below/above128000×3 with message role separators, call envelope, actual schema, examples, neighbour context and assistant/history content
DIFF-REPAIR: added correction/history causes smaller redivision/reduction or an explicit refusal; no oversized call is sent
DIFF-TRANSPORT: provider normalization/schema expansion and isolated fresh-call mode are measured; unmeasured project/tool/session additions are disabled or refused

DIFF-ADMISSION: absent/false boundedStructuredInput support yields zero completion calls; declared support receives the exact shared boundedInput shape and authoritative job.plan.limitChars for all chunk/gather/repair requests.
fixturesNeeded: Independent captured stdin/schema and invocation-argument assertions for configured CLI adapters; include sentinel project/history inputs and a no-child-spawn oversized control.

testLevels.purpose: Exercise existing prepare/review/gather across every fragment and final bounded call.
subjects: DIFF-LARGE: S003-sized inventory evidence produces multiple serial review calls under384000 complete-input characters; every source span is carried by a completed chunk
DIFF-GATHER: gather combines findings and provenance across parent-file fragments; no fragment omitted, out-of-scope finding promoted, or graph coverage invented
DIFF-SCALE: many fragments retain sparse sibling connectivity and avoid new quadratic material construction
DIFF-COMPAT: source-symbol and small-file review parity, cancellation, retries, gather/reduction, duplicate comparisons, and lower configured budgets remain supported

DIFF-PARENT-QUALITY: no chunk emits a local finding; a parent correctness finding is produced only when gather receives facts from two separate fragments. Reject missing/foreign/duplicate parent notes and prove reduction preserves both facts and provenance.

DIFF-READER: through DiffGroundingDeps/git-diff reader, recover truncated per-file input completely or refuse unrecoverable truncation/missing hunks before any model call or completed artifact. Replace the legacy tests that explicitly allow truncated bounded-slice reviews.

DIFF-FACTORY-LIMIT: for each of the five model-dimension factories, a provider cap below configured review size reaches adapter reduction/duplicate budgets, createJob.plan.limitChars and every boundedInput.maxInputChars unchanged. Cover the two deterministic callers without introducing a separate budget.

DIFF-FITS-ONE-CALL: a file larger than16Ki with complete prompt below128K still forces quality chunk mode, validates one note per fragment and executes parent gather. Ordinary non-fragment input remains single-call compatible.
fixturesNeeded: Scripted structured model records actual complete calls and emits bounded valid chunk/gather answers; no fake PASS from missing evidence.

testLevels.purpose: Demonstrate the filed reproduction is unblocked at the original default budget on the approved built runtime.
subjects: DIFF-S003-RETRY: rebuild under Node22 then run the actual independent daemon diff review for484fcef7efaf229e/s3 with128000-token setting; record actual verdict/degraded mode and any remaining errors
fixturesNeeded: Existing S003 approved contract/build/evidence. No automatic user-daemon restart, release enablement, evidence deletion or override approval; report runtime reload needs honestly.

migration.stateBefore: s1 locates buildDiffSymbols emitting a file-level review summary, codeReviewMaterial turning each row into an indivisible atom, and the existing serial planChunks/runReviewJob pipeline. promptChars callers span job, gather and duplicate planning. The filed S003 reproduction exceeds the current per-call budget before a review is recorded; the original128000 setting has been restored.
migration.stateAfter: Fresh diff-review jobs hold complete ordered evidence spans and use the existing bounded serial chunk/gather pipeline. Complete calls include their schema and all supplied context/history under at most128000 estimated tokens. Existing public IPC method names, source-symbol reviews, provider OAuth ownership, S003 historical evidence and disabled release state are preserved.

migrationSteps.action: Add optional diff-fragment provenance and normalize captured large text into complete ordered source spans; preserve small/binary behavior and deduplicate original changed files.
Integrate span material, sparse sibling relationships and provenance-aware gather into the existing adapters; start new review jobs rather than resuming an old oversized pending call.

Apply common complete-call accounting to planning, correction/redivision, gather and final dispatch. Add bounded isolated structured-completion capability with safe defaults for unrelated callers; no global budget/config change.

Run only relevant tests during implementation, then one combined Node22 build and focused review/provider regression sweep. Where existing production-source audit checks require refreshed hashes/classifications for changed review code, update only reviewed source metadata under this fix; retain S003's original measurements and pending proofs. Do not compact/delete/split the audit datasets as a workaround.

After approved runtime activation is available, retry the actual S003 independent diff review at128000. Do not restart an in-use daemon automatically; retain any runtime-activation or review error as pending evidence.

migration.backwardCompat: Internal additive metadata/options only. Rows without fragment provenance retain legacy semantics, and graph-based source-symbol identities and existing review result shapes remain compatible. No new IPC method or persistent domain schema. Existing pending jobs with old whole-file snapshots are restarted as new jobs; no in-place job rewrite or fabricated continuation. Non-review CLI completions retain defaults; bounded diff calls fail explicitly if isolation cannot be enforced.

alternativesConsidered.name: Attributable diff spans in the existing chunk pipeline
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Represent file diffs as ordered bounded source spans, then reuse existing chunk review and gather with complete-call size checks.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Keep one parent file identity and add complete ordered diff-span metadata to its review rows. Plain text, JSON, additions and removals use the same evidence contract; no file must be a single indivisible atom. Every span retains original evidence and source coordinates, and file-level gather judges across span notes. All context and carried history enter explicitly constructed, freshly measured calls under the128K budget; no ambient conversational transcript is carried. Existing source-symbol graph reviews and independent reviewer selection remain intact.
pros: Smallest complete change at the broken file-to-atom boundary.
Works for pretty and minified JSON and other text without inventing a format-specific semantic parser.
Reuses serial review, gather, retries and degraded-coverage reporting.
cons: Continuation spans must expose clear context and offsets, especially for a single very long line.
All file-level consumers must handle one-to-many rows and preserve attribution/completeness.

alternativesConsidered.name: JSON entry review units with a generic diff fallback
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Give JSON object/array entries explicit semantic units and use source spans for non-JSON or oversized values.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Model JSON parent containers and entry identities explicitly, with source coordinates and before/after evidence; review entries independently and gather at the parent. Other diff text and oversized scalar values require the generic bounded-span contract as a fallback. Both paths measure complete rendered calls including schema, context, notes and correction/history under128K, and retain independent degraded review.
pros: Semantic JSON keys make inventory-entry context clearer.
Per-container gather can express relationships among generated entries.
cons: Adds parsing and before/after correspondence rules for arbitrary JSON, duplicate keys and malformed inputs.
Still needs generic spans for giant strings, minified values and non-JSON diffs, creating two attribution paths.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Also meets the constraints but adds a JSON-specific data model while still requiring generic spans for minified giant values; more implementation and compatibility risk without additional requested capability.

sequenceDefinition.narrative: The sequence shows where complete diff evidence is divided and where all supplied context/history/schema must be counted before a serial model call. Parent-file provenance flows through every chunk into gather; the budget guard can stop a call without dropping evidence.

participants.label: Snapshot
participants.description: Owns original per-file text and change-set provenance; no source is reread mid-review.

participants.label: Diff spans
participants.description: Partitions each large captured file into ordered lossless ranges and original source coordinates.

participants.label: Planner
participants.description: Groups complete spans and explicit neighbour/context notes into measurable calls.

participants.label: Input guard
participants.description: Counts envelopes, actual schema, context, history and correction content against the128K cap.

participants.label: CLI provider
participants.description: One fresh CLI-backed request at a time; no unmeasured conversational or tool history.

participants.label: Parent gather
participants.description: Collects all fragment findings and notes, reduces bounded context and preserves degraded review semantics.

messages.label: Capture diff + identity
messages.description: Read limits/incomplete evidence cannot be hidden by chunking.

messages.label: Complete attributed spans
messages.description: The parent owns every span; source ranges reconstruct the captured diff.

messages.label: Full request + schema
messages.description: Payload-only size is insufficient; all added material consumes the same cap.

messages.label: Fit check, then submit
messages.description: Oversized calls are redivided/reduced or refused before dispatch.

messages.label: Facts + provenance
messages.description: Return one validated parent-obligation evidence note per carried fragment, plus local findings/descriptions.

messages.label: Bounded parent evidence
messages.description: Require every parent fragment note, reduce context with provenance when needed, then adjudicate correctness across fragments.

messages.label: Check context/history
messages.description: The same guard applies to every later call, not only initial chunks.

messages.label: Next isolated call
messages.description: No opaque session transcript is resumed.

messages.label: Parent judgement
messages.description: Keep parent-file attribution and existing independent/degraded verdict limits.

citations.quotedText: assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding builds ChangedSymbolSummary rows through buildDiffSymbols; current diff rows are file evidence rather than graph symbols.
promptChars measures the serialized supplied messages; complete-call accounting must also cover the actual supplied schema and later context.
runReviewJob drives calls serially with cancellation, explicit execution modes and pipeline-owned retries.
Each grounding row becomes an atom with file/module ownership and relations; duplicate entity IDs are rejected.
128K chunk limit including any added context/history; use the already filed bug.
Prepare uses review.chunkTokens with the default128000-token limit and fixed3characters/token estimate.
Quality currently has findings/descriptions; chunkNotesFrom extracts only an optional notes array.
Existing obligation/reduction calls can be reused; non-calls sibling relations are not currently adjudicated.
ProviderCapabilities and StructuredCompletionOpts are the existing shared support/option declaration sites.
Legacy tests currently allow a truncated diff to proceed; this intentional behavior change requires explicit recovery/refusal regressions.
Actual headless-browser render and inspected screenshot for the generated companion; control interactions not claimed.
Current build(snapshot) callback has no limit argument; direct source lookup identifies five model and two deterministic dimension callers.
enterStage currently accepts singleCalls when they fit; fragmented parent obligations need an explicit force-chunk selection contract.
Current companion render evidence after canonical third-round regeneration.
